verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents its own UNO API. Headless mode lets external clients control the application through that API, UNO acceptor threads accept remote connections, and the SDK ships API docs and a Developer's Guide. The CLI also covers conversion, printing, text dumping and running macros. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and community reports describe automation through Basic and Python as painful and API docs as hard to find. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity claim, evidence that each app (Writer/Calc/Impress/Draw/Base) is fully scriptable, accessible API reference evidence, hands-on corroboration of broad programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
